messages:
sam_sales: quick sync — Acme wants a Hosted API pricing exception for their POC. They estimate ~1B tokens/month during trial and asked for $0.00045/token. Our published rate is $0.0006. Can we offer an override or tiering?
anya_se: POC details: 30d window, pretty bursty, ~80% gen, 20% embeddings. They'll need security answers fast. From tech side we can add throttles and telemetry.
bruce_pricing: to clarify options: (1) temporary per-token override for N days, (2) custom tiered pricing with thresholds, or (3) minimum monthly guarantee + lower unit price. For 1B tokens at $0.00045 that's $450k/mo — check commit thresholds for discount bands. We also need model family, expected seq lengths, and quantization levels.
emily_dealdesk: high-level: deal desk can provision a 60-90 day per-token override with a minimum charge and an automatic revert to list pricing unless they sign a reserved commit. Example proposal: 60d at $0.00048 with a $50k minimum, or 6mo commit for $0.00042. Legal wants revocation clause + metric measurement method.
sam_sales: customer dislikes min charge. Could we do tiered effective rate so the minimum is waived if they hit >500M tokens in the first 30d?
bruce_pricing: tiering is feasible but must be deterministic. Proposal: billing bands: 0-100M @ $0.0006, 100M-500M @ $0.00052, 500M+ @ $0.00045. For the POC we can front-load an override that maps to these bands, and waive the min if >=500M tokens observed. Need to prevent backfill gaming — add a clause that only forward usage counts and we prorate by day.
emily_dealdesk: approvals: I can prelim approve the 60d override to $0.00048 with a $50k min, or alternate tiering as Bruce suggested pending legal consent. Approver required: VP Revenue Ops. I'll draft the special terms. Billing code will need a custom rate card entry.
acct_ops: note: per-token overrides require a manual rate card row and separate billing code (example code: `HOSTED-PER-TOKEN-OVRD-1718123456`). Lead time ~2 business days to set up invoicing/GL mapping.
security-bot: security note from the questionnaire: Acme requires SOC2 attest + VPC option for production. For a Hosted POC we can offer IP allowlist, customer-managed key for at-rest encryption, and enhanced logging export. Private on-prem/VPC would need separate SOW.
emily_dealdesk: legal items I'll include in the special terms: revocation with 14d notice, measurement by server-side token meter (our primary billing), dispute window 60 days, and requirement to use a single API key per contract.
anya_se: I'll prep a short POC runbook (SLOs, rate limits, telemetry export, prompt set for quality checks) and a rollout checklist to avoid surprise overages. Will attach sample alert thresholds.
sam_sales: perfect — I'll share the two options with the customer today (60d override @ $0.00048 + $50k min OR tiered bands with waiver if >500M tokens). Asking for exec sponsor and model family confirmation. cc @anya_se @bruce_pricing @emily_dealdesk
emily_dealdesk: tagging next steps: I'll open the special terms draft and route to legal + VP RevOps for sign-off. Put timeline in thread. :hourglass:
bruce_pricing: also add an operational control: API key whitelisting + usage notifications at 10%, 50%, 90% of projected consumption.
sam_sales: thanks all. will update once customer responds. :thumbsup:
